previous.observation: Root actual own2464 canonical/guide and raw/fullWB: high close finger group versus low upward-spread hand, head/torso/skirt/leg action and two whole shoes preserved. P1 curl collapses into miniature stacked oval disks/rings at nape, lacking readable two broad large front-return turns plus own small turn and tapered C; visible lower end sits before black sleeve, not hidden-stage or hole-count proof. Low LEFT two beads retained. Shaded/mint reflections and eye tone/inner-dark reading remain P2. Removing colored coil reference failed geometry, so do not repeat that hypothesis unchanged on38. Hidden RGB exterior cloud disappears in WB. Fresh independent same structural P1; no user/dynamic/binding acceptance.
